profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ is a public company headquartered in San Diego, California, trading under the ticker TDC. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0000816761. The company describes itself as the AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment. Its website presents the Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform as a way to make AI real, trusted, governed, and built to scale, and says its product and service portfolio helps organizations use AI, analytics, and cloud solutions.

The company says it partners with leading providers to deliver technology, AI-driven resources, and knowledge. In California, the company is associated with 281 legal exposure matters. No specific product names, MCP servers, or litigation cases are listed in the available facts.
